title: A Visitor for the Choir
author: Orsen Voss
blurb: Gideon Pemberton, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
